question: What power arises from constantly contemplating a smoke-colored form?
premises: One should constantly contemplate a smoke-colored form.
The triple world is the object affected.
The practitioner gains the power to shake it.
inference: By constantly contemplating a smoke-colored form, one can shake the triple world.
uncertainties: The object that is smoke-colored is not explicitly named in this verse.
plain_english: O beloved, by constantly contemplating what is smoke-colored, one can shake the triple world.
